caption: The drawing depicts a tall, narrow, metal coffee pot with a spout on the left and an arched handle on the right. The pot is predominantly brown in color with areas of lighter highlights suggesting reflections or wear. The body, lid, and base are decorated with painted designs: the top and bottom borders have a repeating motif of green and yellow leaf shapes, while the central band around the base displays stylized green leaves, blue leaves, and red berry-like circles interspersed with a few red flower shapes. The lid also features coordinated green and yellow patterns, and the spout and handle both show indications of brown with lighter streaks, suggesting metallic texture and reflections. The background is a plain light tan color, and there are no additional objects in the image.
title: Toleware Tin Coffee Pot
